# Distribution

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Distribution`](gmeow-Distribution.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Distribution>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A concrete distribution artifact of a software product — a tarball, wheel, binary, container image, or installer. The physical/bits facet of the release; identified by content digest.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Distribution`](gmeow-Distribution.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Commit History

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/software/examples/commit-history.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/software/examples/commit-history.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-software-examples-commit-history)#example-slices-extensions-software-examples-commit-history

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: a commit DAG with identity canonicalization and build provenance
# Commits form a directed graph via gmeow:commitAncestor. Each commit's
# author is recorded as a gmeow:AuthorIdentity — the as-committed git identity
# (one of possibly many emails) — which gmeow:canonicalizedIdentity resolves to
# the real gmeow:Agent, so "same person, three git emails" is one agent without
# rewriting history. A gmeow:BuildActivity ties a source commit (gmeow:buildSource)
# to the gmeow:Distribution it produced (gmeow:buildOutput): verifiable provenance
# from source to artifact.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/software/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

ex:dist a gmeow:Distribution ; rdfs:label "myapp-1.0.0.tar.gz"@en .
```
